name: Schmölln (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, yellow and red, charged in the lower part with the city arms of Schmölln (a church and town on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Schmölln; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schmölln arms — church and town on blue
